protocol:
Large Volume Marine Cyanophage Phage Purification
Grow up cells in large volumes (1-2L) to yield ~1011 - 1012 cells using 'microbubbling' technique.
Add Rnase A (10ug ml-1 = for 2L, 250µl of Qiagen's 100mg/ml stock) and DNase1 (0.25 SU ml-1 =2L, add 50µl of stock).
Centrifuge 12,500 rpm (23,975xg) in Beckman Ja-14 for 15 minutes at 4°C Filter the supernatant through a Kim Wipe tissue paper.
Mix in polyethylene glycol (PEG 8,000; 100g L-1) by gentle stirring.
Incubate overnight at 4°C.
Collect PEG-phage precipitate by centrifuge (6 tubes at a time for the 2L volumes) at 12,500rpm (23,975xg) in Beckman Ja-14 for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Gently resuspend pellet into ~1/150 volume Pro99 (~1-2 ml).
Add in resuspension media -place the tube on its side in syrofoam cut-outs so that it rests at an angle.
Put on orbital shaker (150 rpm) in cold room for overnight re-suspension.
Combine resuspended PEG concentrated phage into a single tube (now ready for layering onto a CsCl gradient).
Prepare a CsCl step gradient (1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.65 bands) in ultracentrifuge tubes.  
Add concentrated phage sample at top.
Spin 28,000 rpm for 4 hours at 4°C in SW28 swinging bucket rotor.
Remove purified phage band (interface of ρ = 1.4 and 1.5 bands on step gradient). 
Step dialyze in Slide-A-Lyzer dialysis cassettes (Pierce #66425; 10K MWCO, 0.5-3.0 ml volume) - 30 minutes against 5xNaCl (3M), 3xNaCl (1.8M), two changes of 1xNaCl buffer [MTM100 = 600 mM NaCl, 100 mM TrisHCL (pH = 7.5), 100 mM MgCl2].  
Store dialyzed particles at 4°C until needed. 
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature. 
Add 116g NaCl per Liter of lysate (thus 2M addition + seawater yields final concentration ~2.6M).
Incubate on ice 30 minutes.

parameters.container: PEG-phage precipitate (6 tubes at a time for 2L volumes)

other.position: tube on its side in styrofoam cut-outs at an angle

parameters.reagent: purified phage band (interface of ρ = 1.4 and 1.5 bands)

parameters.container: Slide-A-Lyzer dialysis cassettes (Pierce #66425; 10K MWCO, 0.5-3.0 ml volume)
reagent: 1xNaCl buffer [MTM100 = 600 mM NaCl, 100 mM TrisHCL (pH = 7.5), 100 mM MgCl2]

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: grow (container: large volume vessel (1-2L), reagent: cells (marine cyanophage host), volume: 1-2L, other: {'technique': 'microbubbling', 'yield': '~10^11 - 10^12 cells'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='cell culture (2L)', reagent="Rnase A (Qiagen's 100mg/ml stock)", volume='250µl', final concentration='10ug/ml')
add(container='cell culture (2L)', reagent='DNase1 (stock)', volume='50µl', final concentration='0.25 SU/ml')
centrifuge(container='cell culture', temperature='4°C', duration='15 minutes', speed='12,500 rpm (23,975xg)', rotor='Beckman Ja-14')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: filter (container: supernatant, other: {'filter': 'Kim Wipe tissue paper'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
mix(container='filtered supernatant', reagent='polyethylene glycol (PEG 8,000)', volume='100g/L', method='gentle stirring')
incubate(container='PEG mixture', temperature='4°C', duration='overnight')
centrifuge(container='PEG-phage precipitate (6 tubes at a time for 2L volumes)', temperature='4°C', duration='15 minutes', speed='12,500 rpm (23,975xg)', rotor='Beckman Ja-14')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: discard (container: supernatant, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
resuspend(container='pellet', reagent='Pro99', volume='~1-2 ml (~1/150 volume)')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: add (container: tube with pellet, reagent: resuspension media (Pro99), volume: ~1-2 ml, other: {'position': 'tube on its side in styrofoam cut-outs at an angle'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
shake(container='tube with pellet and Pro99', temperature='cold room', duration='overnight', speed='150 rpm', device='orbital shaker')
combine(container='resuspended PEG concentrated phage', destination='single tube')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: prepare (container: ultracentrifuge tubes, reagent: CsCl solutions (1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.65 bands), other: {'type': 'step gradient'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='ultracentrifuge tube with CsCl gradient', reagent='concentrated phage sample', position='at top')
centrifuge(container='ultracentrifuge tube (SW28 swinging bucket rotor)', temperature='4°C', duration='4 hours', speed='28,000 rpm')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: remove (container: ultracentrifuge tube, reagent: purified phage band (interface of ρ = 1.4 and 1.5 bands), other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
dialyze(container='Slide-A-Lyzer dialysis cassettes (Pierce #66425; 10K MWCO, 0.5-3.0 ml volume)', reagent=['5xNaCl (3M)', '3xNaCl (1.8M)', '1xNaCl buffer [MTM100 = 600 mM NaCl, 100 mM TrisHCL (pH = 7.5), 100 mM MgCl2]'], duration='30 minutes (each step)', steps='stepwise against listed buffers')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: store (container: dialyzed particles, temperature: 4°C, duration: until needed, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
incubate(container='dialyzed particles', temperature='room temperature', duration='1 hour')
add(container='lysate', reagent='NaCl', volume='116g/L', final concentration='2M addition + seawater yields ~2.6M')
incubate(container='lysate with NaCl', temperature='on ice', duration='30 minutes')
